name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 15, after point b – Am 36
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ba) Calls for dedicated and reinforced funding to rapidly scale up the rescEU firefighting fleet through the procurement, maintenance, and strategic deployment of firefighting aircraft such as Canadair and helicopters; insists that operational priority be given to Southern Europe’s island and peninsular regions, which stand on the frontlines of catastrophic mega-fires and the climate crisis;
